title.value: Extract expenses from receipt photos sent via chat

introduction.value: A bookkeeping assistant for freelancers and small businesses reads receipt photos sent through Telegram or Discord and extracts vendor, amount, tax, category and date.

method.value: The builder made AICountant for freelancers and small businesses as a Telegram or Discord bot. Users connect one of those accounts, send a receipt photo, and the AI pulls out vendor, amount, tax, category, and date, then adds the expense to a ledger for review before the user can export it as CSV.

outcome.value: The post says the product was already functional and the creator was recruiting beta testers to validate usage patterns. They specifically wanted real receipts from different countries, formats, and industries to find weak spots in extraction.

notes.value: The main catch was coverage: they were still testing on varied real-world receipts to improve accuracy, so reliability across formats was not yet proven.

source_text.body:
Extract expenses from receipt photos sent via chat
A bookkeeping assistant for freelancers and small businesses reads receipt photos sent through Telegram or Discord and extracts vendor, amount, tax, category and date.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The builder made AICountant for freelancers and small businesses as a Telegram or Discord bot. Users connect one of those accounts, send a receipt photo, and the AI pulls out vendor, amount, tax, category, and date, then adds the expense to a ledger for review before the user can export it as CSV.
How it went
The post says the product was already functional and the creator was recruiting beta testers to validate usage patterns. They specifically wanted real receipts from different countries, formats, and industries to find weak spots in extraction.
Worth knowing
The main catch was coverage: they were still testing on varied real-world receipts to improve accuracy, so reliability across formats was not yet proven.
Try it yourself
with
n8n
Copy prompt
Build a workflow that triggers when I send a receipt photo to my [Telegram/Discord] bot. It should extract vendor, amount, tax, category, and date, then append a row to my [Google Sheet name]. Test it with [3] sample receipts and show me the rows it created. Flag any receipt it cannot read clearly instead of guessing.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/SideProject/comments/1s8p0aq/i_built_an_ai_bookkeeper_that_extracts_expenses
